subject: Bonding instructions and IOR for Redwood demo shipment
messages:
From: James Smith <james.smith@pacificfreight.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@pacificfreight.com
Date: 2026-11-07T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Advance shipment - bonding / IOR question

Hi Ava,

We have the advance pallet shipment (BOL 84231) inbound to the staging warehouse for your SF show. The venue has flagged a bonding requirement and is asking who the Importer of Record (IOR) should be. The paperwork we received lists the venue as consignee but does not state IOR explicitly.

Quick questions: can you confirm Redwood's preference for IOR on this shipment (Redwood Inference / client IOR / venue IOR)? If Redwood will be IOR we need the EIN and authorized signer for release. If the venue must be IOR, please confirm contact and signed authorization.

Also FYI: the warehouse sent a cutoff note saying freight must be admitted by 11/08 09:00 local — they did not specify timezone in the notice. I flagged this as potentially PT but wanted to confirm.

Attaching the BOL and the warehouse notice we were given.

Thanks,
James
James Smith
Pacific Freight Co. — Account Executive
[Attachment: bill_of_lading_84231.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: James Smith <james.smith@pacificfreight.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Advance shipment - bonding / IOR question

Thanks James — quick clarification: Redwood must be listed as Importer of Record. Do NOT accept venue as IOR. Please update the paperwork to show:

  - Importer of Record: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  - EIN: 12-3456789
  - Authorized release: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai / +1 415-555-0182)

Marissa, Ben — looping you in. If the warehouse needs a separate form for bonded release, please advise; we need release confirmed before cutoff.

Also, confirm whether the warehouse cutoff is 11/08 09:00 PT — the broker language was ambiguous. If the cutoff is PT we may be tight on timing for updates.

Ava
Ava Chen
Field Marketing Programs | Redwood Inference

From: James Smith <james.smith@pacificfreight.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@pacificfreight.com; IRVenue Ops <ops@irvenue.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T18:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Advance shipment - bonding / IOR question

On Sun, Nov 7, 2026 at 3:04 PM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks James — quick clarification: Redwood must be listed as Importer of Record. Do NOT accept venue as IOR. Please update the paperwork to show:
>
>   - Importer of Record: Redwood Inference, Inc.
>   - EIN: 12-3456789
>   - Authorized release: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai / +1 415-555-0182)
>
Understood. I have spoken with the venue logistics contact and they are insisting they act as IOR due to their insurance/bonding policy — see ops@irvenue.com copied. They say their internal policy prevents them from releasing bonded shipments if they're not IOR.

IRVenue Ops replied that they can be IOR but only with a signed venue release form. If Redwood cannot sign that form they will hold at the venue which could delay delivery to the on-site staging window.

Regarding cutoff: the staging warehouse notice is 11/08 09:00 PT (they just confirmed it is PT). I've attached the notice text.

I can escalate to their customs team but need explicit instruction from Redwood if we are to insist on Redwood as IOR — otherwise the venue will proceed with being IOR to get the shipment admitted.

James
[Attachment: warehouse_cutoff_notice.txt (plain text)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Smith <james.smith@pacificfreight.com>, IRVenue Ops <ops@irvenue.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T07:54:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Advance shipment - bonding / IOR question

James —

Do NOT accept the venue as IOR. Redwood will be IOR on all advance shipments for this show (security requirement). James, please instruct Pacific Freight to update BOL/entry and customs paperwork immediately to list Redwood Inference, Inc. as IOR (use the EIN Ava provided). Send updated paperwork to Marissa Cole for signature and send a confirmation to the warehouse ops team for release.

If the venue requires a signed authorization form from Redwood, IRVenue Ops, provide the form and we will sign it but only as an authorization to release — not transferring IOR status. Hannah, please standby to coordinate an expedited drayage move if admission is delayed past cutoff.

If the shipment misses the 11/08 09:00 PT admission window because of paperwork changes, we will expect Pacific Freight to cover any same-day reroute or expedited cartage fees — please confirm acknowledgement.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Global Logistics Lead | Redwood Inference
[mobile: +1 415-555-0147]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, James Smith <james.smith@pacificfreight.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Advance shipment - bonding / IOR question

Quick update: Pacific Freight updated the entry to list Redwood Inference as IOR and the warehouse has released the shipment for delivery to the offsite staging. However, because the change happened after their manifest cutoff, the carrier assessed a same-day reroute fee of $1,295. Pacific Freight says they will submit for credit per Marissa's note but wanted internal approval to front the charge if needed to keep build on schedule. Attached the reroute invoice.

Can we approve the charge to avoid delay? If we approve now, I'll pay and then coordinate reimbursement/credit with Pacific. If we want to dispute, we need Pacific to confirm acceptance of liability in writing before any further payments.

Ben
Ben Carter
Field Operations Supervisor | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: reroute-invoice-1297.pdf (PDF)]
